description: A two-level stone bridge spans stylized waves, with long horizontal deck lines and repeated arches. A large central lower arch sits beneath a smaller upper arch, flanked by partial arch openings at both sides.
A domed igloo has a flat lower edge interrupted by a central arched doorway. A short pole grows from the summit and carries a small right-pointing triangular flag.
An igloo has a broad rounded dome and a flat base interrupted by a central arched entrance. A short horizontal seam extends inward from the left side across the upper portion of the wall.
A tapered lighthouse rises from a wavy waterline to a rounded lantern roof and small finial. Horizontal bands divide the tower and lantern, while one short upright window sits in the middle section.

A tapered lighthouse stands on a straight baseline beneath a rounded lantern roof and short finial. A horizontal seam marks the lantern, a short line marks the doorway, and detached beams radiate to either side.
A windmill has a tapered tower with an arched doorway beneath four broad sails arranged as a diagonal cross. The sails meet above the body, and a horizontal ground line extends beyond the tower base.
A small gabled house has projecting eaves, a tall right-side chimney, and a rectangular doorway. A jagged crack descends from the left roof slope into the upper wall of the otherwise blank facade.

Four tightly clustered houses overlap in two staggered rows, each with a simple gabled roof and straight walls. The rear houses rise above the foreground pair, with open lower edges and an uneven right wall.

A group of simple houses occupies two staggered rows, with taller gabled silhouettes behind a lower foreground pair. The front-left building has a shallow sloping roof, while the front-right building has an asymmetric gable.
